note: Market-derived edges plus, where shown, a WATCH-MODE opinion from the player projection engine (calibrated held-out; pass yards withheld by its failed gate; NOT YET GRADED -- no prop ledger exists, so these carry no track record). Fair value for edges is the DE-VIGGED MULTI-BOOK CONSENSUS, and the edge is the best available price against it -- this finds mispriced BOOKS, not mispriced players. Engine chips are labeled watch-mode opinions, and these are not Play/Lean verdicts.
